author: TeIq
content: Observation: leptos 0.8.4+ requires Rust 1.88. The workspace pins Rust 1.85 (matching proto-blue). Latest leptos compatible with 1.85 is 0.8.3 (rust_version=1.80). Options: (A) pin leptos=0.8.3 in workspace.dependencies — keeps 1.85 MSRV, loses ~16 patch releases of leptos; (B) bump workspace rust-version to 1.88 — requires architect approval, violates the 1.85 constraint in the issue plan; (C) use a workspace.dependencies version spec that lets Cargo pick 0.8.3 when building under 1.85. Choosing option A: pin leptos to 0.8 with a Cargo.lock floor of 0.8.3 by specifying leptos = '0.8.3' in workspace.dependencies. The 0.8.x semver range means future upgrades are a one-line bump once the MSRV is raised.
